comment: App Links (handle_all_urls) for secretsanta.circletools.ch. The fingerprints are Play's APP SIGNING keys (Play Console > App integrity > App signing). The app signing key was ROTATED, so both are listed (kept in step with the Main copy's get_login_creds list; see ADR-0069). First entry (FD:D7…): CURRENT app signing key. Second entry (BB:EF…): PREVIOUS app signing key. Both read from Play Console on 2026-10-06. (App-Links validation already accepts a lineage cert — this showed 'verified' on device before — but listing both app-signing certs keeps it correct across rotation.)
